$comment: Pinned runtime of Bogen for macOS. scripts/fetch-runtime.mjs downloads these on macOS and refuses any file whose SHA-256 differs from a pinned value; --frozen (CI and releases) also refuses an unpinned one. Provenance of the pins (2026-11-21, recorded in a normal HTTPS session, no binary executed): Node from nodejs.org's SHASUMS256.txt for v26.13.1; chrome-headless-shell 158.0.8127.36 (revision 1727472) as listed in Chrome for Testing's known-good-versions-with-downloads.json, hash observed from the complete official archive after a zip integrity check. Chrome for Testing publishes no checksum file, so that hash is a pinned observation, not a Google-published checksum.

layout.$comment: Where the runtimes sit inside Contents/Resources (and vendor/<arch>). The headless shell's folder must not be named like its executable: codesign would take such a folder for a shallow bundle (scripts/sign-plan.mjs).
